title: Chapter 163: Encountering A Battle On The Road
content:
Chapter 163: Encountering A Battle On The Road

The Naga warriors led the Zerg army out of the Zerg-controlled area and entered the war zone. They could see scouts from all sides appearing from time to time, and occasionally had brief confrontations with scouts from the evil god camp.

Most of these scouts were sent by the Tengu tribe's affiliated territories. Their territories entered the front line of resisting the invasion of the evil god camp, and they could only struggle desperately to get a way to survive.

The Naga warriors and Zerg puppies were very fast. Sometimes the scouts of the two sides who were fighting had not reacted yet, and the Naga warriors rushed to the vicinity.

At this time, the Naga warriors showed their superb archery skills. The Naga warriors who were close to the scouts of the evil god camp walked at an unslowed speed while drawing their bows and arrows. One arrow could shoot down a scout from the evil god camp from a distance.

It was a piece of cake for the Naga warriors to destroy the scouts of the evil god camp they encountered.

The scouts of each territory of the local camp stood solemnly, watching the Naga warriors and the endless Zerg puppies flying away.

The news here will spread out soon.

Along the way, no large groups of enemies were encountered, and the scattered enemy teams were all sent away by the Naga warriors.

After marching at such a high intensity for nearly three hours, Nagalong finally ordered the Naga warriors to stop, and the Zerg puppies behind also stopped moving forward.

"Leader No. 3, the front is the junction of our sphere of influence and the sphere of influence of the Tengu tribe. We need to rest here!"

"There may be emergencies ahead. We must recover and be ready to fight at any time!"

Nagalong said to host No. 3.

"The guest follows the host's wishes!"

Host No. 3 had no objection to this and ordered the Zerg puppies to rest and wait on the spot.

1,000 explosive mosquitoes also fell into the Zerg puppies. They can fly for a long time, but landing to rest can save energy consumption.

The Naga warriors took out the drinking water and dry food they carried with them and ate on the spot to recover.

Two hundred thousand Zerg puppies stopped quietly in place without making a sound, and the silence was a little scary.

Nagalong and the Naga warriors were impressed by the performance of the Zerg puppies. These Zerg troops, which seemed to be just ordinary Zerg troops, turned out to be real elite troops.

Two hundred thousand elite troops, this is a very powerful force, enough to determine the victory or defeat of a war.

Nagalong saw the sincerity of the Zerg, and the Naga tribe would also see Wu Qing's sincerity.

...

The Naga warriors and the Zerg army rested for an hour, and after fully recovering from the consumption, they set out again.

This time it was a normal marching speed, and they were no longer rushing at full speed.

Entering the Naga territory, the situation became different, and the two armies fighting could be seen everywhere.

This area is considered to be the side of the Naga sphere of influence. The enemy is the bear goblin tribe of the evil god camp, which are some of the troops familiar to the Zerg.

Unlike the Tengu tribe, the Naga tribe has a particularly high proportion of warriors of the Naga tribe. In almost every battlefield, Naga warriors fight side by side with warriors of other races.

The morale of these Naga armies is obviously much higher than that of the Tengu army!

Through the perspective of host No. 3, Wu Qing can feel that the soldiers here still have hope in their hearts, unlike the lifeless appearance of the Tengu army.

From this point, it can be seen that the war between the Naga tribe and the evil god camp has wins and losses, and it is not like the Tengu tribe that was defeated to the end and completely defeated.

At the beginning, they encountered very small-scale battles, which were solved by a few waves of bows and arrows by the Naga warriors rushing in the front. After going deep into the Naga territory for a distance, they finally encountered a battle of tens of thousands of people.

The Zerg puppies moved. If there is a battle, the Zerg must participate!

A battle of tens of thousands of people cannot be solved by a few arrows of the Naga warriors. Naga Long did not need to say much, the Zerg puppies rushed out, and killed the army of the evil god camp in the vigilance of both sides!

After the Zerg puppies’ strength was improved, it was the first time to officially participate in the war.

They are faster, more powerful in attack and defense. Except for the one-star soldiers, there are not many ordinary soldiers in the world that are stronger than them!

Zerg puppies rushed towards the enemy like a black tide, and countless blades passed by. The enemies were slaughtered like paper people and disappeared in light.

"Sacrifice on the battlefield!"

Nagalong and the Naga warriors were very surprised to see such a scene!

At this time, the Naga army also saw Nagalong and others with the Zerg puppies. Knowing that the reinforcements were their own people, they cooperated with the Zerg puppies to slaughter the enemy.

A battle of not large scale ended quickly.

The Naga warriors were preempted by the Zerg puppies because they used bows and arrows first. They were also shocked by the Zerg's battlefield sacrifice ability and powerful combat power. They were almost equivalent to not participating in the battle.

"Leader No. 3, it turns out that the Zerg can sacrifice on the battlefield. This is really an amazing ability!"

"Such an ability will scare those evil god believers!"

Nagalong said to host No. 3 with some envy.

In this world, sacrifices are usually made by using secret techniques to offer sacrifices to the gods or powerful people of faith in order to obtain rewards.

Most sacrifices require corresponding rituals, just like the ritual of offering sacrifices to evil gods. Sacrifices cannot be made casually.

The ability to directly perform large-scale sacrifices on the battlefield is very rare.

"This is the ability of the Great Lord!"

Host No. 3 brought out the Zerg Overlord.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

With the endorsement of the great power, many things do not need to be explained, because no one understands, and they just don't know when asked!

A Naga tribe member came to Nagalong and told Nagalong some of the latest news.

"Leader No. 3, this time you may need to participate in the war in advance!"

"Just got the latest intelligence, a large army of the bear goblin tribe is going to pass through this area and penetrate behind the battlefield in front of our tribe. Our tribe is organizing the army and militia of various territories to intercept!"

"The scattered troops of our tribe seen along the way are all the troops and militias called to assemble!"

"If this army of the evil god camp successfully penetrates behind the battlefield of our tribe, it will have a great impact on the entire battlefield situation!"

"I decided to intercept this enemy army immediately. I wonder what Leader No. 3 thinks?"

After Nagalong got the new information, he hurried to find Host No. 3 and explained the situation. This was to ask the Zerg reinforcements to directly participate in the war.

Logically speaking, Nagalong cannot represent the entire Naga tribe. It is reasonable for the Zerg not to formally participate in the war before the cooperation is settled.

But the Zerg is warlike and will never hesitate to fight!

From the perspective of Wu Qing and the entire Zerg, the Zerg should go to war earlier and earn more resources on the battlefield, so that the Zerg can send out more powerful reinforcements and gain greater benefits, thus forming a good cycle.

The Zerg fights and becomes stronger!

"No problem! We are here to fight!"

Host No. 3 readily agreed to Nagalong's suggestion, which made Nagalong very grateful.

Nagalong found the general of the front combat unit, said something, and led the Naga warriors and the Zerg army to march at full speed to the northeast!

The war in front is urgent and cannot be delayed for a moment!

With the marching speed of the Naga warriors and the Zerg puppies, more than ten minutes later, the shouts of killing in front were heard, and a war was unfolding in front.

Wu Qing could already see the situation on the battlefield through the flying host No. 3.

The lineup of this battlefield was no less impressive than the battle between the Tengu and the Bugbears that the Zerg participated in!

The priest group led by the conspicuous white-robed Bugbear High Priest stood at the highest point of the central army of the evil god camp, commanding an army of at least 300,000 evil god believers to launch a fierce attack on the Naga army!

Behind the evil god camp army, there were also a large number of logistics support troops following. This was a planned large-scale military operation!

"It turns out that the strategic focus of the Bugbears is here. Are they going to defeat the Naga first like the Tengu?"

Wu Qing finally understood why there were no larger gathering points of the evil god army near the Zerg-controlled area. It turned out that they were all attacking northward.

He learned from some intelligence that the Naga tribe was much more tenacious than the Tengu tribe. While facing powerful enemies, they also endured the pressure that the Tengu tribe should have borne, and were also attacked by the two powerful tribes of the evil god camp!

Under such circumstances, they could still fight to the death and hold on until now, and they were still trying to stop the evil god camp from advancing.

From this, it can be seen that the strength of the Naga tribe is strong, and their indomitable spirit is even more admirable!

On the battlefield, the Naga tribe opposite the evil god camp army is much weaker. The coalition forces of various races with the Naga tribe as the core have less than half of the troops of the evil god camp army.

But their morale is very high. With a lot of luck, they fearlessly charge at the powerful enemy opposite!

The spirit of these Naga troops is much stronger than that of the Tengu army!

However, facing the fanatic army that has no independent thoughts at all, spiritual will alone cannot make up for the absolute gap in strength between the two sides.

This battlefield is like a vortex that attracts the Naga army, sucking the army of the Naga territory here. From all directions, small groups of Naga troops continue to rush to the battlefield.

"Attack the enemy and rescue them, gather the scattered enemies, this is the rhythm of preparing for full occupation!"

There are many Naga territories in this area, and it is very troublesome to clean them up one by one. In this way, a war will consume the war potential of this area and lay a good foundation for full occupation.

The bear goblin tribe sent troops this time to attack the rear of the Naga tribe's front battlefield from the flank, forcing the Naga tribe to do their best to stop it. This is an open conspiracy.

This calculation is indeed well made. Wu Qing is not clear about the relationship between the races in the evil god camp. He doesn't know whether this combat operation is a close cooperation between the two sides or the bear goblin tribe is arbitrarily seizing the benefits.
